037/**
038 * Shared abstract base for the {@link RestBuilder} flavor builders ({@code RestServlet.Builder},
039 * {@code RestResource.Builder}, {@code RestMixin.Builder}).
040 *
041 * <p>
042 * Each fluent {@code @Rest}-member setter is implemented <b>once</b> here and forwards into a backing
043 * {@code RestAnnotation.Builder} &mdash; the override bag.  At {@link RestContext} construction time the bag is
044 * turned into a synthetic, highest-priority {@code @Rest} annotation that is prepended to the resource's
045 * {@code @Rest} chain, so builder-supplied values <b>take precedence</b> over the class's own
046 * {@link Rest @Rest} annotation values.
047 *
048 * <h5 class='section'>Self type (CRTP):</h5>
049 *
050 * <p>
051 * {@code SELF} is the concrete builder type, left open through the flavor builders and their user subclasses so
052 * that bespoke setters on a subclass chain with true covariant returns.  Setters return {@link #self()}.
053 *
054 * @param <R> The resource type produced by {@link #build()}.
055 * @param <SELF> The concrete builder type (self type).
056 * @since 10.0.0
057 */
058@SuppressWarnings({
059   "unchecked", // CRTP self-type cast in self() is safe by construction.
060   "java:S1452", // Wildcard return on getResourceType() is intentional.
061   "java:S119" // 'SELF' (CRTP self-type) is intentional and clearer than a single-letter name.
062})
063public abstract class AbstractRestBuilder<R,SELF extends AbstractRestBuilder<R,SELF>> implements RestBuilder<SELF> {
064
065   private final Class<R> resourceType;
066   private final RestAnnotation.Builder anno = RestAnnotation.create();
067   private final Map<String,Object> extras = m();
068   private Boolean mdcAsyncPropagation;
069
070   /**
071    * Constructor.
072    *
073    * @param resourceType The resource type produced by {@link #build()}.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
074    */
075   protected AbstractRestBuilder(Class<R> resourceType) {
076      this.resourceType = assertArgNotNull("resourceType", resourceType);
077   }
078
079   /**
080    * Returns this builder cast to the self type.
081    *
082    * @return This object.
083    */
084   protected final SELF self() {
085      return (SELF)this;
086   }
087
088   /**
089    * Builds the configured resource instance.
090    *
091    * @return A new resource instance configured by this builder.
092    */
093   public abstract R build();
094
095   /**
096    * Reflectively instantiates the resource type, preferring a {@code (RestBuilder<?>)} constructor (constructor
097    * injection) and falling back to the no-arg constructor.
098    *
099    * <p>
100    * Flavor builder {@code build()} implementations call this then stash {@code this} on the returned instance.
101    *
102    * @return A new, uninitialized resource instance.
103    */
104   protected R createResource() {
105      var ci = ClassInfo.of(resourceType);
106      var ctor = ci.getDeclaredConstructor(x -> x.hasParameterTypes(RestBuilder.class)).orElse(null);
107      if (ctor != null)
108         return ctor.accessible().newInstance(this);
109      var noArg = ci.getNoArgConstructor(Visibility.PRIVATE)
110         .orElseThrow(() -> isex("Resource class %s has no no-arg or RestBuilder<?> constructor.", resourceType.getName()));
111      return noArg.accessible().newInstance();
112   }
113
114   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
115   // Override-bag accessors (consumed by RestContext during construction)
116   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
117
118   /**
119    * Returns the resource type produced by this builder.
120    *
121    * @return The resource type.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
122    */
123   public Class<?> getResourceType() {
124      return resourceType;
125   }
126
127   /**
128    * Returns the synthetic {@code @Rest} annotation carrying all builder-set members, for use as the
129    * highest-priority contributor of the {@code @Rest} resolution chain.
130    *
131    * @return The synthetic annotation.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
132    */
133   public Rest toRestAnnotation() {
134      return anno.build();
135   }
136
137   /**
138    * Returns the programmatic MDC async-propagation override, or <jk>null</jk> if not set.
139    *
140    * @return The override, or <jk>null</jk> if not set.
141    */
142   public Boolean getMdcAsyncPropagation() {
143      return mdcAsyncPropagation;
144   }
145
146   /**
147    * Returns the forward-compat extras set via {@link #set(String, Object)}.
148    *
149    * @return An unmodifiable view of the extras map.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
150    */
151   public Map<String,Object> getExtras() {
152      return u(extras);
153   }
